The API handler additionally deletes the memo's comment memos first (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:610-618`).

**q22.** Dispatcher: `APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15` (called from `CreateMemo`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`; it delegates to `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, `:47`). Delivery package: `internal/webhook` (`webhook.PostAsync` → `Post`, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`, `:120`). Signing: HMAC-SHA256 over `msgID + "." + timestamp + "." + body`, base64-encoded, sent as Standard-Webhooks headers `webhook-id` / `webhook-timestamp` / `webhook-signature: v1,<sig>` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:132-149`).

**q24.**
```
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:178 (useCreateMemo → memoServiceClient.createMemo)
web/src/connect.ts:186 (memoServiceClient)
proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:21 (MemoService.CreateMemo)
```

**q25.** Engine: CEL (`github.com/google/cel-go`) wrapped by the in-repo filter package `internal/filter` (`internal/filter/engine.go:14-33`, compile at `:47`). Mechanism: `Engine.Compile` turns the CEL expression into a dialect-agnostic condition tree (`internal/filter/ir.go`), then `renderer` (`internal/filter/render.go:31`) emits dialect-specific SQL + args via `RenderOptions{Dialect}`, and each driver calls `filter.AppendConditions(..., filter.DialectSQLite|DialectPostgres|DialectMySQL, &where, &args)` to append the rendered predicate to its `ListMemos` WHERE clause (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:54-58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:65-69`; helper `internal/filter/helpers.go:9`).

**q26.** `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo` (directly, via `store/memo.go:140-159` + `store/db/*/memo.go DeleteMemo`), plus `memo` again for comment memos deleted by the API handler (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:610-618`), and `memo_share` by declared FK `ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/*/LATEST.sql`, sqlite:107 / postgres:108 / mysql:108). Note: SQLite is opened with `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`), so that cascade is not enforced on SQLite. `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but never deleted.

**q27.** Mechanism: the built `web/dist` output is embedded into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware with an SPA fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:21-22` (embed) and `FrontendService.Serve` at `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:41-60` (`middleware.StaticWithConfig`, `spaFallbackMiddleware`).

**q28.**
```
s3presign.Runner — started at server/server.go:162-170: RunOnce once at startup, then a time.Ticker every 12h (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41)
```
Unused infra notes: `server/runner/memopayload` has a `Runner`/`RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:19,27`) that the server never starts — only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is called inline from memo handlers (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`). The cron scheduler package `internal/scheduler` (`scheduler.go`, `parser.go`, `middleware.go`) is not referenced anywhere outside its own tests/examples.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:148-172` (installed on the transport at `:177`). Tokens: short-lived JWT access token held by `web/src/auth-state.ts` (localStorage + in-memory, `memos_access_token`, 15 min) sent as `Authorization: Bearer`, and a long-lived refresh token in the httpOnly cookie `memos_refresh` sent via `credentials: "include"` (`web/src/connect.ts:56-61`), refreshed through `AuthService.RefreshToken` (`web/src/connect.ts:72`). Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go`, `server/auth/token.go`; constants at `token.go:37-52`), wired into the gateway/Connect via `server/router/api/v1/authz.go` + `connect_interceptors.go`. Personal access tokens (`memos_pat_` prefix) are validated by the same package (`server/auth/authenticator.go:102`).

**q30.**
```
memo created: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15 (called memo_service.go:157)
memo updated: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:20 (called memo_update_helpers.go:67)
memo deleted: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:25 (called memo_service.go:562)
memo comment created: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:30 (called memo_service_comments.go:119)
```
Convergence: the first three funnel through `APIV1Service.dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:47`), and all four end at `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` / `:120`.
